Bug_Details: Instant APIs only work for NANOS, MICROS, MILLIS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS, HALF_DAYS and DAYS.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by attempting to add WEEKS to an Instant using the plus method with ChronoUnit.WEEKS. This is incorrect because Instant APIs only support adding NANOS, MICROS, MILLIS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS, HALF_DAYS, and DAYS.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method of the InstantTemporalUnitBug class, which attempts to add WEEKS to an Instant using the plus method with ChronoUnit.WEEKS. This triggers the bug because Instant APIs only support adding NANOS, MICROS, MILLIS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS, HALF_DAYS, and DAYS.
